summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares Dynamic Short-Term Active ETF (CSHP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that primarily invests in short-duration investment-grade fixed income securities. The fund may also use derivatives and limited equity and currency exposures to seek total return. CSHP was launched on Jul 17, 2024 and is issued by BlackRock.
